title: FarikRole
description: What a role is: its mandate, what it produces, what it may not do, its default model, and its skills, stored as roles/<role_id>/role.yaml next to system.md and skills/. A role's permission tiers and session limits are not here: they are the governor's defaults (farik_core::governor::permissions::default_tiers, farik_core::budget::default_session_limits), overridden per agent in the team file. See docs/SPEC.md section 6.

id.description: The role, equal to its directory's name. `human` is a role a contract may name as a reviewer, never one an agent is instantiated from.

mandate.description: What the role is for, in a sentence or a paragraph.

produces.description: What the role's work leaves behind.

forbidden.description: What the role may not do. The governor enforces in code what it can of this; the list is what the role is told.

id.description: The provider's model id the role runs on unless the agent names its own in the team file.

effort.description: How hard the model thinks by default.

skills.description: The skills the role ships with, each the name of a directory under skills/ holding a SKILL.md.
